title: ERG intensity-response (Naka-Rushton)
background: b-wave amplitude versus flash intensity per condition, fit with the Naka-Rushton saturating function — the standard ERG intensity-response model. Reports Vmax, semi-saturation log K, and slope n; the fit is honestly omitted for null conditions that can't be fit.

references.title: S-potentials from luminosity units in the retina of fish (Cyprinidae)
references.note: The Naka-Rushton saturating function V = Vmax·Iⁿ/(Iⁿ+Kⁿ) used for the fit.

references.title: ISCEV Standard for full-field clinical electroretinography (2022 update)
references.authors: Robson AG, Frishman LJ, Grigg J, et al.
references.note: Defines the b-wave amplitude measured at each intensity.

catalog.name: Selom ERG Intensity-Response
catalog.summary: b-wave amplitude versus flash intensity for each condition, with a Naka-Rushton saturating fit (V = Vmax·Iⁿ/(Iⁿ+Kⁿ)) overlaid. Reports Vmax, semi-saturation log K, and slope n per condition. Reads the long ERG metrics table; condition colours + order match the trace grid; the fit is honestly omitted for null conditions that can't be fit.
